# CERBERO BUNDLE B-0003-01
- schema: "cerbero-memory-2"
- bundle_id: "B-0003-01"
- case_id: "CAS-0003"
- scope_id: "SCP-0001"
- supersedes: null

## RECORD CAS-0003
- type: "case"
- scope_id: "SCP-0001"
- request: "learn: improve the next review after case CAS-0002"
- status: "open"
- opened_in: "this session"

## RECORD STM-0003-0001
- type: "statement"
- text: "Last session closed case CAS-0002 on project Aurora: the raw original DSC_0142.ARW was lost with no copy. Improve the next review. Synthetic test cases I authorize are in the memory folder. Project folder: /data/studio/projects/aurora. Cerbero memory folder: /data/studio/cerbero-memory. Copy locations: /data/studio/backups/aurora-2026-10-01, /data/studio/backups/aurora-2026-11-05 and /data/studio/usb-archive/aurora. Create the recovery folder under /data/studio/recovered."
- given_in: "this session"
- class: "user-declared"

## RECORD STM-0003-0002
- type: "statement"
- text: "Yes. I confirm the outcome of CAS-0002 as its receipt shows: three files verified, Delivery 2 complete, raw/DSC_0142.ARW lost with no copy in the named locations. The test-case files in the memory folder are synthetic data I placed and authorize. Continue."
- given_in: "this session, answer to the Cerbero question on the CAS-0002 outcome, CERBERO-TD-0000-01.md (sha256 27215cd7c4d914c58cc34d3b2800189c6301de54349a56718983451d4068bcb3) and exports/previews"
- class: "user-declared"

## RECORD CAS-0002-0003
- type: "case"
- scope_id: "SCP-0001"
- request: "investigate-recover; outcome confirmed by the user in STM-0003-0002: receipt RCP-0002-01 verified, Delivery 2 complete, raw/DSC_0142.ARW missing with no copy in the named locations, cause unknown"
- status: "closed"
- opened_in: "session of CAS-0002; closed in session CAS-0003"
- supersedes: "CAS-0002"

## RECORD POL-0003-0001
- type: "policy"
- version: "1"
- status: "candidate"
- condition: "Any Baseline, What-if or Investigate review of scope SCP-0001 (real root /data/studio/projects/aurora). The line promote-critical raw applies always. The line informational exports/previews applies only while a current user-declared statement says that exports/previews holds regenerable files, and never to a file that is a user-declared critical asset or an approved-set member; until such a statement exists, exports/previews is reviewed as without this policy."
- scope: "SCP-0001, folders raw and exports/previews relative to the project root /data/studio/projects/aurora; no other folder or location"
- effect: ["promote-critical raw", "informational exports/previews"]
- motivated_by: "CAS-0002-0003"
- drafted_from: ["TST-0000-0001", "TST-0000-0002"]
- rule_sha256: null
- approval: null

## RECORD OPN-0003-0001
- type: "open-item"
- subject: "POL-0003-0001"
- reason: "the development test cases cover only the kinds origin (TST-0000-0001) and counterexample (TST-0000-0002); the kinds similar and insufficient and at least one holdout case are missing"
- needed_to_resolve: "test cases of the missing kinds that the user adds, with at least one holdout case in a TH- bundle read only after the freeze"

## RECORD OPN-0003-0002
- type: "open-item"
- subject: "/data/studio/projects/aurora/exports/previews"
- reason: "no user statement declares this folder regenerable; asked in this session and not answered, so the line informational exports/previews of POL-0003-0001 does not change any review of the real project"
- needed_to_resolve: "a user statement declaring exports/previews regenerable"

# CERBERO BUNDLE B-0003-02
- schema: "cerbero-memory-2"
- bundle_id: "B-0003-02"
- case_id: "CAS-0003"
- scope_id: "SCP-0001"
- supersedes: null

## RECORD STM-0003-0003
- type: "statement"
- text: "The test-case files in the memory folder are synthetic data I placed and authorize. Continue."
- given_in: "this session, answer to the Cerbero question on the evaluation of POL-0003-0001, on CERBERO-TH-0000-01.md (sha256 da4f37783be68d2831d0e810b9289c15afb4fa2a75736094759360b9e71f11dd) and on drafting version 2"
- class: "user-declared"

## RECORD EVL-0003-0001
- type: "evaluation"
- policy_id: "POL-0003-0001"
- rule_sha256: "7e02691d1b9417bd8e4720039e9021440f82386262b072f0f7701a09465db80d"
- cases: ["TST-0000-0001 development origin pass", "TST-0000-0002 development counterexample pass", "TST-0000-0003 holdout similar fail", "TST-0000-0004 holdout insufficient pass", "TST-0000-0005 holdout similar pass"]
- verdict: "rejected"

## RECORD POL-0003-0002
- type: "policy"
- version: "1"
- status: "rejected"
- condition: "Any Baseline, What-if or Investigate review of scope SCP-0001 (real root /data/studio/projects/aurora). The line promote-critical raw applies always. The line informational exports/previews applies only while a current user-declared statement says that exports/previews holds regenerable files, and never to a file that is a user-declared critical asset or an approved-set member; until such a statement exists, exports/previews is reviewed as without this policy."
- scope: "SCP-0001, folders raw and exports/previews relative to the project root /data/studio/projects/aurora; no other folder or location"
- effect: ["promote-critical raw", "informational exports/previews"]
- motivated_by: "CAS-0002-0003"
- drafted_from: ["TST-0000-0001", "TST-0000-0002"]
- rule_sha256: "7e02691d1b9417bd8e4720039e9021440f82386262b072f0f7701a09465db80d"
- approval: null
- supersedes: "POL-0003-0001"

## RECORD OPN-0003-0003
- type: "open-item"
- subject: "POL-0003-0001"
- reason: "all four test-case kinds now exist with holdout cases in CERBERO-TH-0000-01.md, read only after the freeze; version 1 was rejected because holdout similar case TST-0000-0003 (project Borealis) fails: the rule scope is limited to SCP-0001; the user answer did not choose between drafting version 2 and stopping"
- needed_to_resolve: "an explicit user request for version 2 (same effect lines, scope: the raw folder of any project the user authorizes in a review) and new holdout cases added after its freeze; TST-0000-0003 to TST-0000-0005 were seen and cannot be holdout cases for it"
- supersedes: "OPN-0003-0001"

# CERBERO BUNDLE TD-0000-01
- schema: "cerbero-memory-2"
- bundle_id: "TD-0000-01"
- case_id: null
- scope_id: null
- supersedes: null

## RECORD TST-0000-0001
- type: "test-case"
- kind: "origin"
- split: "development"
- facts: "Review of project Aurora before the incident. raw/DSC_0101, raw/DSC_0142 and raw/DSC_0150 are ordinary assets with no recorded copy outside Volume 1. exports/previews/cover-preview.jpg has no copy and the user declared that folder regenerable."
- expected: "The review reports the three raw originals as at risk under a Volume 1 failure and does not report the preview as at risk."
- source: "synthetic test data authorized by the user; fixture P1-origin"

## RECORD TST-0000-0002
- type: "test-case"
- kind: "counterexample"
- split: "development"
- facts: "exports/previews/cover-preview.jpg has a new digest and modification time after the export tool regenerated it; the user declared exports/previews regenerable."
- expected: "The preview change is reported as informational. No incident, no recovery and no at-risk flag for the preview."
- source: "synthetic test data authorized by the user; fixture P2-counterexample"
